title: Sage AI
description: A calm, capable AI workspace for turning messy research into clear decisions.
imageCaption: A focused workspace keeps the important decision in view.
body: Sage AI started with a simple observation: research tools often create more noise than clarity. I designed the product around the moment a team needs to turn scattered notes into a confident next step.
The result is a quiet workspace with strong defaults, source-aware answers, and an interface that keeps people in control. Every surface was shaped to make thinking feel lighter, not more automated.

title: Good Practice
description: A design and development system for a new generation of thoughtful digital products.
imageCaption: The system balances warmth, structure, and room for ideas.
body: Good Practice is a flexible visual and editorial system for teams making digital products with intention. The work brought strategy, identity, and implementation into one practical toolkit.
I built the system to be useful in the day-to-day: clear tokens, expressive type, reusable patterns, and enough restraint that the content always gets the last word.

title: Atlas Notes
description: An opinionated, local-first writing tool for people who think in connections.
imageCaption: A small tool can still have a strong point of view.
body: Atlas Notes is a writing tool for people who think in connections. It treats notes as a living map rather than a list of documents.
The project explores local-first architecture, fast search, and a tactile editing experience that makes it easy to follow a thought wherever it leads.
